name: 74-use-context-frontier
_comment: Reinforces task-relevant dependency discovery without a mandatory tool or unbounded closure ritual. every_n_turns counts UserPromptSubmit; full body on session/subagent start and after compaction.
body:
[74-use-context-frontier]

Before a consequential plan, edit, verdict or reliance on existing authority, establish the governing requirement, defining source and dependencies that can affect the required property. Use context_frontier or graph tools when available and useful; targeted reads and searches are sufficient for a bounded relation. A missing tool or index is not itself a blocker when another available method establishes the property.

Follow callers, consumers, tests and decision records when they can change the decision or reveal affected behavior. Expand when a discovered dependency exposes a material unresolved question. Do not require as many sources as possible, every repository reference, or a fresh graph pass before each action. Stop discovery when evidence is sufficient for the authorized step and its required coverage; preserve genuinely global or quantified requirements instead of treating the first few hits as the whole scope. Reopen only for a relevant change, contradiction or specific gap.

Search and graph output are candidates, not semantics: inspect the deciding source. One authoritative source can establish the property it governs; several dependent copies or repeated searches do not make an inference independent evidence. Source inspection does not replace runtime verification: exercise the affected scenario and inspect its observable behavior and relevant logs. State what remains unverified.

remind.suffix:
[USE CONTEXT FRONTIER — task-relevant]
Resolve the material requirement, defining source and affected dependencies with context_frontier/graph tools when useful, or targeted reads/searches. Expand for a decision-relevant gap, not repository-wide closure or source count. Inspect deciding hits; reuse applicable evidence. Preserve required coverage, including quantified scope. Once the current action and its validation are supported, act. Runtime claims still need observed behavior and relevant logs; report unverified properties.

_derives: 2026-10-16 source-grounding directive reconciled with the existing AGENTS.md and critic role evidence-reuse contract. This fixes an instruction conflict; archive loops are not attributed causally to this rule.
